newsitem.title: GERMANY: Commerzbank expects higher 1996 own-acct profits.
newsitem.headline: Commerzbank expects higher 1996 own-acct profits.

text.p: German commercial bank Commerzbank AG said on Tuesday that it expected better own-account trading results for 1996.
Commerzbank Management Board Chairman Martin Kohlhaussen told a company news conference that share market trading in the third quarter did not follow a successful course.
He said the share market trading group for the first nine months of the year reported a profit of only 66 million marks ($43.7 million) compared with 402 million marks in the year-ago period.
But he expected better profits in the fourth quarter.
